audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-3 are given to Kled/Skill while their whys say Karma out-ranges him for free and calls 4-5 'your bullying peak'; row 4 is given to Karma while its why literally opens with 'Even'; row 5 is Kled while its why says you reclaim the bullying window.
audit.why: Pre-6 Kled has no ranged answer to a 950-range Q and a whiffed 800-range Bear Trap strands him. His ult at 6 is the equaliser and 2+ items is his. The packet chart agrees: Karma 0-3, Skill 4, Karma 5, Kled 6.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, Kled in both layers, with ratings re-scaled to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why was boilerplate and never named Chaaaaaaaarge!!! or its cost, despite the packet flagging that no Kled ability is named anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s with 3500/4000/4500 travel range and grants a shield — that is what makes 6 an equaliser rather than a Karma window.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the 140s cooldown and the 3500-unit range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Violent Tendencies (W) is never mentioned, and the Bear Trap shackle condition and Jousting's double-dash are absent.
audit.why: W gives four rapid attacks with the fourth amplified, so the burst tell is the first auto wind-up, not a cast. Bear Trap only yanks if the shackle survives its duration. Jousting is 550 range on 13/12/11/10/9s and must be recast back through the target.
audit.corrected: Auto-reset tell added to the Don'ts, the 11s free-cost Bear Trap into the Do's, and the shackle/Jousting mechanics into the interactions row.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 but travels 3500 units — your Mantra at 6 is the same empower it always was.

edits.before: Kled whiffs Bear Trap on a Rope and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1 and free to cast — walk up only after it misses.

edits.before: That is Kled’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies is four fast autos, not one — shield before the first.

edits.before: Track Kled’s Bear Trap on a Rope: The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Bear Trap only yanks if the shackle holds — the 800-range throw is dodgeable, and Jousting is 550 with a mandatory dash back through you.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Hold Focused Resolve' is a false positive — Focused Resolve is Karma's real W. diff HARD at 8/10 sits oddly against a 53.85% win rate (13 games, tiny sample); I left diff/diffRating/breakdown.difficulty untouched rather than desync the prose.
